Coram : K.M. JOSEPH*, HRISHIKESH ROY
Civil Procedure Code, 1908 – Or. XLI, r. 31 – Duty of first Appellate Court – Reappreciation of evidence – Consideration of arguments and arriving at findings – Suit was filed by the plaintiff (wife of first defendant) seeking inter alia declaration of two documents i.e. gift deeds as void – Trial Court came to the conclusion that the plaintiff was a pardahnashin lady and the character of the document was not brought to the notice of the plaintiff – Gift deeds were declared void
Decision Date : 19-04-2022 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 14699/2015 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
